title: Software Developer Intern
description:
Software Developer - Intern 
 Company: Nigo Compliance Private Limited Location: Erode, Tamil Nadu Duration: 46 Months Stipend: Unpaid (No Stipend) 
 About the Internship We are looking for enthusiastic and motivated Software Engineer Interns who are eager to learn full-stack web and mobile application development. Interns will receive practical exposure to modern technologies and work on learning-oriented tasks and real-world projects under the guidance of our development team. 
 What You Will Learn Learn the fundamentals of web and mobile application development through practical tasks. Assist senior developers in building user interfaces using React.js and Next.js. Gain practical knowledge of backend development using Node.js and GraphQL. Learn to work with PostgreSQL databases and perform basic SQL queries. Practice writing clean, readable, and reusable code with guidance from the development team. Learn to identify, debug, and resolve basic coding errors. Explore React Native for mobile application development. Participate in team discussions, code reviews, and technical learning sessions. Work on assigned tasks and mini-projects to strengthen programming skills. Understand version control using Git and learn the basics of application testing and deployment. Collaborate with team members to understand software requirements and development workflows. 
 Skills Required Basic knowledge of JavaScript or TypeScript. Familiarity with HTML, CSS, and fundamental programming concepts. Basic understanding of React.js is preferred. Familiarity with databases and SQL is an advantage. Interest in learning Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, GraphQL, and React Native. Good logical thinking and problem-solving skills. Willingness to learn new technologies and work collaboratively. 
 Eligibility Students pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, as well as recent graduates, may apply. Candidates should have a strong interest in software development and willingness to learn. Basic programming knowledge and problem-solving skills are expected. Academic projects, personal projects, or a GitHub portfolio will be an added advantage. 
 What You Will Gain Hands-on learning experience in full-stack web and mobile development. Exposure to modern technologies used in SaaS application development. Practical understanding of frontend development, backend APIs, and databases. Guidance from the development team to strengthen technical skills. Experience with software development workflows, version control, testing, and debugging. Opportunities to build practical projects and develop a strong technical foundation. 
 Internship Details Duration: 46 Months Stipend: Unpaid Work Location: Erode, Tamil Nadu 
 How to Apply: Send your resume and GitHub profile (if available) to ask@nigo.app . 
 Note: This is an unpaid internship for a duration of 46 months.

Key Skills: Software,Postgresql,Typescript,Software development,Node.js,Nextjs,Graphql,HTML/CSS
